Features

Everything you'd expect from a serious IRC client.

The same IRC you already know — the bouncer, the slash commands, the mode prefixes, the formatting — running in a browser, on our infrastructure, synced to every device you sign in from.

01 / always-on

#always-connected

Our edge fleet of bouncers stays in the channel 24/7. Power off your laptop, take a flight, lose wifi — when you sign back in, every message is waiting.

24/7 bouncer·auto-reconnect
02 / scrollback

#full-history

Every message, in every buffer, stored in our cloud. Scroll back through a week of conversation or a year — same scrollback, same slash commands.

infinite·searchable
03 / sync

#any-device

Modern web app that works in every browser, on every device. Open it on your phone, switch to a desktop, jump to a tablet — the same buffers follow you.

responsive·pwa-ready
04 / networks

#multi-network

100+ IRC networks preconfigured — Libera, OFTC, hackint, EFnet, QuakeNet, and more. Add your own private network with one form.

libera·byo
05 / search

#fast-search

Instant full-text search across every buffer, every network, every device. Find a link someone shared years ago or every mention of your nick in the last 30 days.

full-text·cross-buffer
06 / themes

#beautiful-ui

Themes: dark, midnight, compact, monospace, custom CSS. mIRC formatting with 16 base colors and hex RGB. Emoji picker, file uploads, pastebin.

themes·mirc

FAQ

Common questions, honest answers.

If yours isn't here, ask in #ircfiber @ libera or email team@ircfiber.com.

01Where are my messages stored?+
On our infrastructure. We run a multi-region edge fleet (US-East, EU-West, AP-South) backed by encrypted-at-rest storage. You pick the region at signup; we don't move your data between regions without telling you. We never sell, share, or mine your messages — they're yours, full stop.
02Do I need to install anything?+
No. The web app runs in any modern browser. No native client, no Electron wrapper, no npm install. You can install it as a PWA to your home screen for a more app-like feel, but that's optional.
03What if I already use a desktop client like WeeChat or HexChat?+
Keep using it. IRC Fiber's gateway exposes a standard bouncer protocol, so you can point WeeChat, HexChat, irssi, mIRC, or anything else at it and get the same always-on buffer state. The web app is the convenience layer; you're not locked into it.
04Can I add my own private IRC network?+
Yes. The network form takes hostname, port, password, and SASL credentials. The bouncer maintains the connection just like the public networks. 100+ public networks are preconfigured (Libera, OFTC, hackint, EFnet, QuakeNet, and more).
05Can I export my data?+
Yes. We offer a one-click export of every buffer as plain text or JSON, so you can take your scrollback with you if you ever decide to stop using the service.
